name: Unholy Confessions
source: Unholy Confessions is a romantic and supernatural visual novel where you can explore a tiny church in the middle of nowhere and meet its tennants. Everything is not what it seems, so be careful to not fall for into the clutches of the beasts.
translation: 《Unholy Confessions》是一部浪漫超自然的视觉小说，你可以在其中探索一座偏僻的小教堂并遇见它的住户。一切并不像看上去的那样，所以要小心，不要落入野兽的魔掌。
